habitat: 七日登录第 7 天赠送
evolution: 迪莫 → 圣光迪莫 / 圣火迪莫 / 圣水迪莫 / 圣草迪莫（首领化超进化）
evolutionEn: Dimo → Sacred Light / Fire / Water / Grass Dimo (Alpha Ultra Evolution)
description: 国服人气核心精灵，光系万金油，七日登录第 7 天免费获得。被动「最好的伙伴」造成克制伤害后提升攻击/防御/速度并回复能量，PVE 全能输出、PVP 稳定增益。S2 赛季开放圣火、圣水、圣光、圣草四种超进化形态，需消耗首领血脉与超进化石。
descriptionEn: The most popular CN core Jinie and a Light-type all-rounder, earned free on Day 7 of login. Its passive "Best Buddy" boosts ATK/DEF/SPD and restores energy after super-effective hits, making it a PVE workhorse and a stable PVP booster. S2 added four Ultra Evolutions (Sacred Fire / Water / Light / Grass) requiring Alpha Blood and Ultra Evolution Stones.

name: 火花
evolution: 火花 → 焰火（Lv16）→ 火神（Lv36）→ 烈火战神（超进化）

descriptionEn: The Fire-type starter with the highest ATK and SPD of the three. Its "Combustion" passive adds +20% ATK after each Fire move (stackable), ramping up the longer a fight goes. Fastest early-game and story progression; the other starters can be caught in friends' worlds after level 10.

evolution: 水蓝蓝 → 波波拉（Lv16）→ 水灵（Lv36）→ 圣水守护（超进化）
evolutionEn: Shuilanlan → Bobola (Lv16) → Shuilin (Lv36) → Sacred Water Guardian (Ultra Evolution)

descriptionEn: The Water-type starter with the "Permeation" trait: Water skills cost 1 less energy, enabling near-zero-cost output. Balanced defenses and HP plus solid control skills; after evolving into Shuilin it becomes a PVP and long-game cornerstone.

evolution: 喵喵 → 喵呜（Lv16）→ 魔力猫（Lv36）→ 叶冕魔力猫（首领进化）
evolutionEn: Miaomiao → Miaowu (Lv16) → Molicat (Lv36) → Leaf-Crown Molicat (Alpha Evolution)
description: 草系御三家，特性「氧循环」使用草系技能回复 10% 生命（首领化 20%），坦度与续航御三家最高。进化喵呜、魔力猫后成为队伍堡垒，首领进化叶冕魔力猫后续航与增益兼备，佛系开荒首选。
descriptionEn: The Grass-type starter with the "Oxygen Cycle" trait: Grass skills heal 10% of max HP (20% in Alpha form) — the tankiest and most self-sustaining of the three. Evolving through Miaowu into Molicat makes it a team fortress, with the Alpha form adding sustain and buffs.

name: 皇家狮鹫
habitat: 天空城（捕捉小狮鹫起养成）

descriptionEn: A popular Flying-type Jinie with strong ATK and SPD. Its "Wind Combo" passive grants +1 combo after each Flying skill, and Wing Dash secures the first move — solid in both PVE finishing and PVP rush teams. The page-game era's iconic mount king remains a fast physical attacker.

descriptionEn: A Ground/Dark physical juggernaut with top-tier ATK stats. Its "Stone Feast" trait spends 5% HP in place of 1 energy when short, and with Greed's 100% lifesteal it forms an infinite drain loop — a PVE all-rounder and boss-fight staple.

Evolving into Ice Wraith adds the "Frozen Seal" trait (all enemy skills cost +1 energy), and combined with energy-pressure skills can lock bosses out of acting — a PVE boss specialist and PVP control pick. Beats Grass, Ground, Dragon, and Flying, though its frail frame needs protection.

description: 地系 T0 精灵（官方图鉴名：绒光优优，光/地系技能双修）。特性「哨兵」回合开始时若敌方技能足以击败自身，则速度 +50 并在行动后脱离，折返高频上下场掌控节奏；配合流沙 / 摇篮曲控场、硬化 + 放晴强化双防与输出，控场、增益、输出三位一体。
descriptionEn: A Ground-type T0 Jinie (officially "Rongguang Youyou") blending Light and Ground skills. Its "Sentinel" trait grants +50 SPD and a post-action pivot when an enemy move would KO it at turn start — enabling tempo-controlling switch-ins. With Quicksand / Lullaby control plus Harden and Clear Sky boosts, it covers control, buffing, and damage in one.

descriptionEn: Its white fur is very fluffy and its soles are soft, so it moves silently and is good at hiding in grasslands and on slopes. It has a quiet personality, and members of the same species usually communicate by gently butting horns.

name: 铃兰羊
evolution: 锥尾羊 → 铃兰羊 Lv.20 → 花影羚羊 Lv.32
description: 白天会懒洋洋地趴在草原上休息，主要在早晨和黄昏行动，一般会脱离种群独自生活。跳跃力惊人，在山坡上如履平地，从100米的高度一跃而下也没事。

description: 仅仅看到它触角上闪烁的荧光就会头痛难耐，对其研究很难有进展。没有生命迹象但是可以自如活动，无法判定是植物还是动物，唯独颈间圆环中似乎蕴含强大生命力。
descriptionEn: Merely seeing the flickering light on its antennae causes an unbearable headache, making research on it hard to advance. It shows no signs of life yet moves freely; whether it is plant or animal cannot be determined — only the ring around its neck seems to contain powerful vitality.

evolution: 石肤蜥 → 石刺蜥 Lv.32 → 石冠王蜥 Lv.48
description: 常在半山腰处被发现，独立生活，会收集细小的石头筑巢。背上的石头是体内生长出来的一种分泌物，喜欢钻到石头堆里蹭背，可以把背上的石头打磨得更锋利。

descriptionEn: Its teeth are sharp and it loves to gnaw on hard pieces of wood. The palms of its hands are very hard and rough; they are often seen rubbing their hands back and forth over their faces — not washing their faces, but filing their teeth with their palms.

description: 对外表有很高的追求，除了磨牙的习惯之外，体内分泌的油脂会被用来保养胡须。蓬松的胡须和锋利的牙齿代表其在族群中的地位，部分獭会去寻找枯草装作假胡子戴着。普遍不喜欢和洛克亲近。

Fluffy whiskers and sharp teeth represent its status within the group, and some of them seek out dead grass to wear as fake whiskers. They generally do not like getting close to Roco.

description: 稀兽花种的幼年形态，非常轻，会随风而动，身后有像翅膀一样的苞片，苞片上有特殊的薄膜，可以起到防风防水的效果，保护它们健康成长。
descriptionEn: The juvenile form of the rare beast flower species. It is very light and drifts with the wind. Behind it are wing-like bracts covered with a special membrane that is windproof and waterproof, protecting them as they grow up healthy.

name: 伏地兽
habitatEn: Caught from a 5-star Shiny Flower Seed
evolution: 伏地兽 → 贪食鼹 Lv.20 → 巨噬针鼹 Lv.32
description: 柔韧的吻部十分有弹性，没有牙齿，用舌头和吻部配合嘬取食物。每天吃几十只蚂蚁就可以存活，能量消耗很小，多数时间在睡觉。
descriptionEn: Its flexible snout is very elastic. It has no teeth and uses its tongue together with its snout to suck up food. Eating a few dozen ants a day is enough for it to survive; its energy consumption is very small, and it spends most of its time sleeping.

evolution: 伊贝儿 → 伊贝粉粉 Lv.28

The moss itself is not water-repellent, so once it gets wet it quickly absorbs water and becomes heavy, making it sluggish or even unable to walk, so it can only stay where it is and wait to dry naturally. evolution: 白发懒人 → 动力猿 Lv.18 → 瞌睡王 Lv.36
description: 一直闭着眼睛在睡觉，即使是醒了也看不出来。在它睡着的时候也能对听到的声音有所反应，仿佛是个熟练的梦游者。
descriptionEn: It sleeps with its eyes always closed, and even when awake you cannot tell. It can still react to sounds it hears while asleep, as if it were a skilled sleepwalker.

evolution: 白发懒人 → 动力猿 Lv.18 → 瞌睡王 Lv.36
description: 有一半的时间在睡觉，极少保持清醒，清醒时精力极其旺盛。会使劲捶打胸口努力让自己变得清醒，但是卖力地运动过后睡得更沉了。
descriptionEn: It spends half its time sleeping and is rarely awake; when awake its energy is extremely vigorous. It pounds its chest hard trying to make itself wake up, but after exercising so strenuously it sleeps even more deeply.

evolution: 白发懒人 → 动力猿 Lv.18 → 瞌睡王 Lv.36
description: 比较难找到它的眼睛，主要靠鼾声来判断它是不是醒着。即使危险就在面前也能睡得香香的，或许是强大的体格给了它这样做的底气。
descriptionEn: Its eyes are rather hard to find, so people mainly rely on its snoring to tell whether it is awake. It can sleep soundly even with danger right in front of it — perhaps its powerful build is what gives it the confidence to do so.

name: 海盔虫
evolution: 海盔虫 → 刺盔虫 Lv.26 → 千棘盔 Lv.42 → 千棘海针
evolutionEn: Haikuichong → Cikuichong Lv.26 → Qianjikui Lv.42 → Qianjihaizhen
description: 它静止时像不起眼的礁石，让人很难判断这是不是生物。它以底栖方式缓慢移动，活动量与食物多少直接相关，食物少时一天可能只挪动一点点。棘刺间分布感光细胞，使它对强光十分敏感，常本能地躲向阴影。
descriptionEn: When motionless it looks like an unremarkable reef rock, making it hard to tell whether it is a living thing. It moves slowly along the bottom, and its activity level is directly related to how much food there is; when food is scarce it may move only a tiny bit in a day. Light-sensing cells are distributed among its spines, making it very sensitive to strong light, so it instinctively hides toward the shadows.

skills.name: 防御
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%. Counters attacks.

skills.name: 甩水
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; recovers 1 energy for itself.

skills.name: 蓄水
skills.description: 下次使用的技能能耗-6。
skills.descriptionEn: The next skill used costs 6 less energy.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the enemy gains 2 layers of Poison.

skills.name: 腐化
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，敌方获得双攻-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on the enemy, the enemy gets both attack stats -30%.

skills.name: 许愿星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 疫病吐息
skills.description: 敌方获得1层中毒印记。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 1 layer of Poison Mark.

skills.name: 泡沫幻影
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%. Counters attacks: withdraws itself.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. For each layer of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost is -1; the enemy gains 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 毒雾
skills.description: 将敌方所有增益，转化成中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Converts all of the enemy's buffs into Poison.

skills.name: 涌泉
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能能耗每-1，威力+10。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. For every 1 reduction in this skill's energy cost, its power is +10.

skills.name: 盐水浴
skills.description: 自己获得全技能能耗-2，应对防御：改为技能能耗-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains -2 energy cost on all of its own skills. Countering a defense: -3 energy cost instead.

skills.name: 感染病
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若击败敌方则将中毒转化为中毒印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. If it defeats the enemy, converts Poison into Poison Mark.

name: 刺盔虫
evolution: 海盔虫 → 刺盔虫 Lv.26 → 千棘盔 Lv.42 → 千棘海针
evolutionEn: Haikuichong → Cikuichong Lv.26 → Qianjikui Lv.42 → Qianjihaizhen
description: 刺上会卡着贝壳，木片，海藻。长长的棘刺有大量感光细胞，对光线非常敏感，具有负趋光性，为了逃避光线会在日间抓着各种东西为自己遮挡光线。食物充足时移动距离也会稍微变大。
descriptionEn: Shells, wood chips and seaweed get caught on its spines. Its long spines contain large numbers of light-sensing cells, making it very sensitive to light and negatively phototactic, so during the day it grabs all kinds of things to shade itself from the light. When food is plentiful, the distance it moves also becomes slightly greater.

evolution: 海盔虫 → 刺盔虫 Lv.26 → 千棘盔 Lv.42 → 千棘海针
evolutionEn: Haikuichong → Cikuichong Lv.26 → Qianjikui Lv.42 → Qianjihaizhen

descriptionEn: Normally it still moves sluggishly, but when in danger it can briefly accelerate to escape lit and threatening areas. When lightly touched, its spines quickly converge and point toward the point of contact; the venom sacs at the spine tips can cause stinging pain and mild numbness.

descriptionEn: It looks like a pear, smells like a pear, and tastes like a pear too. When it sleeps it hides its body in the mud, leaving only its flower above ground. If a little wasp comes to pollinate it, it becomes very distressed.

skills.name: 撒娇
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击。自己获得萌化：威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 3 hits. Gains Cutify for itself: power permanently +20.

skills.name: 晒太阳
skills.description: 驱散敌方所有增益。

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit. For each layer of Cutify on all creatures carried by both sides, this skill's hit count is +1.

skills.name: 击鼓传花
skills.description: 自己脱离，下个入场精灵继承自己增益。
skills.descriptionEn: Withdraws itself; the next creature to enter inherits its buffs.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. In countering state: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

name: 一窝蜂
evolution: 一窝蜂 → 黄蜂后 Lv.21 → 花魁蜂后 Lv.38 → 女王蜂
evolutionEn: Yiwofeng → Huangfenghou Lv.21 → Huakuifenghou Lv.38 → NWangfeng
description: 悬浮着的蜂巢就像身体的一部分一样灵活运动。可能是受某种信息素或者魔法影响，总会默契地做出协同的动作。
descriptionEn: The floating hive moves as flexibly as if it were part of its body. Possibly influenced by some pheromone or magic, it always acts in tacit coordination.

skills.name: 鸣叫

skills.name: 虫群
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，本技能会受奉献影响。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; this skill is affected by Devotion.

skills.name: 翅刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，驱散敌方所有印记，应对状态：改为偷取印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; dispel all enemy marks; on counter: steal marks instead.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Swift; on counter: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.

evolution: 一窝蜂 → 黄蜂后 Lv.21 → 花魁蜂后 Lv.38 → 女王蜂
evolutionEn: Yiwofeng → Huangfenghou Lv.21 → Huakuifenghou Lv.38 → NWangfeng
description: 在蜂后的下半身周围有能量波动，推测是用来建立两只小蜂的联系。战斗时，蜂后的两眼会变成红色，针刺也会变得锋利无比。

habitatEn: Commonly found in grasslands and forests
evolution: 一窝蜂 → 黄蜂后 Lv.21 → 花魁蜂后 Lv.38 → 女王蜂
evolutionEn: Yiwofeng → Huangfenghou Lv.21 → Huakuifenghou Lv.38 → NWangfeng
description: 只有最尊贵的蜂后能得到加冕，穿着金色的华美虫衣，有淡淡的花香味，女王蜂以信息素的方式向周围的蜂群传递自己的命令。
descriptionEn: Only the most noble queen bee can be crowned, wearing a gorgeous golden bug robe with a faint floral scent. The queen bee transmits her commands to the surrounding swarm through pheromones.

name: 小夜
evolution: 小夜 → 紫夜 Lv.26 → 朔夜伊芙 Lv.44
description: 身手敏捷的小猫，擅长在雾气中隐藏身形，也可以幻化成其他物体。常常以惊讶和恐惧为食，消化后会散发出一种奇怪的味道。
descriptionEn: An agile little cat that excels at hiding its figure in the mist and can also morph into other objects. It often feeds on surprise and fear, emitting a strange smell after digesting.

skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; restore 1 energy to self.

skills.description: 造成物伤，并吸血100%。

skills.descriptionEn: If the enemy restores HP this turn, instead lose 2x (including overheal). First-strike +1.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 2-hit combo.

skills.description: 脱离，应对防御：额外使敌方攻击技能能耗+4。
skills.descriptionEn: Escape; on counter-defense: additionally increase enemy attack-skill energy cost by 4.

name: 紫夜
evolution: 小夜 → 紫夜 Lv.26 → 朔夜伊芙 Lv.44
description: 经常四处游历，偶尔幻化成其他精灵的样子之后偷偷潜入其他族群中，猜测是为了锻炼自己的幻化能力。通常情况下喜欢独自生活。
descriptionEn: Often travels around, occasionally morphing into the appearance of other creatures and sneaking into other groups, presumably to train its own illusion ability. Usually prefers to live alone.

evolution: 小夜 → 紫夜 Lv.26 → 朔夜伊芙 Lv.44
description: 喜欢在远处观察其他精灵的活动，有时会故意制造幻象来测试目标的反应。几乎不与同类接触，有些排斥社交，意外的是，被亲近的洛克抚摸的话耳朵尖会发光。

evolution: 小草虫 → 草衣虫 Lv.20 → 花衣蝶 Lv.36

descriptionEn: In a mutualistic symbiosis with fruit trees, pollinating while collecting nectar among them. The flower at its tail is a siphoning feeding organ used to suck and store pollen, making it the most important population among flower-visiting insects.

descriptionEn: Its original tail fell off and turned into a flower in hand, seemingly containing magic energy usable as a wand. On cold winter rainy nights, thousands of Huayidie gather to rest on bare trees, then scatter at dawn, like a mirage of one-night blooming.

descriptionEn: Its giant wings can deliver powerful strikes to enemies, and spinning further increases its striking efficiency. It excels at both physical and magical attacks; its wings contain immense magic, and the veins inside the wings show traces of flowing magic.

evolution: 风铃鲨 → 蓝蝶鲨 Lv.20 → 彩蝶鲨 Lv.40 → 神谕鲨
evolutionEn: Fenglingsha → Landiesha Lv.20 → Caidiesha Lv.40 → Shenyusha
description: 如果看见它们在水面上大量聚集，往往预示着快要下雨。它们的尾巴摆动时带起细小涟漪，薄膜边缘会在气流中轻轻振动，发出清亮悦耳的声响。
descriptionEn: If you see them gathering in large numbers on the water surface, it often signals that rain is coming soon. Their tails stir up tiny ripples as they swing, and the membrane edges vibrate gently in the airflow, producing clear, pleasant sounds.

evolution: 风铃鲨 → 蓝蝶鲨 Lv.20 → 彩蝶鲨 Lv.40 → 神谕鲨
evolutionEn: Fenglingsha → Landiesha Lv.20 → Caidiesha Lv.40 → Shenyusha
description: 它的身体构造至今难以完全解释：体内几乎都是水，身体被一层透明的膜包裹住，里面的液体非常轻。飞行时，由于压力变化或者风势太大，液体有时会漏出来。
descriptionEn: Its body structure is still hard to fully explain: it is almost entirely water inside, wrapped in a transparent membrane, and the liquid inside is very light. When flying, due to pressure changes or strong winds, the liquid sometimes leaks out.

name: 神谕鲨
habitat: 常见于湖泊 / 轻飘飘精灵
habitatEn: Commonly found at lakes / light-floating spirits
evolution: 风铃鲨 → 蓝蝶鲨 Lv.20 → 彩蝶鲨 Lv.40 → 神谕鲨
evolutionEn: Fenglingsha → Landiesha Lv.20 → Caidiesha Lv.40 → Shenyusha
description: 暴雨时，它将雨水储藏在身体中；干旱降至，它在半空挥舞翼膜，水分升空化作雾墙，再聚成雨云。“这一路上，跌跌撞撞，有时快乐，有时候感伤，可是它依然坚强，哪怕真的没有尽头，它都愿意继续前行。”
descriptionEn: During heavy rain, it stores rainwater in its body; when drought comes, it waves its wing membranes in the air, sending moisture up to form a fog wall, then gathering it into rain clouds. "Along this journey, stumbling, sometimes happy, sometimes sad, yet it remains strong, willing to keep going even if there is truly no end."

name: 忽幽狸
evolution: 忽幽狸 → 影狸 Lv.36
description: 忽幽狸的尾巴覆盖着剧毒尖刺，静止时会伪装成灌木枝条。当感知到危险，尾巴会瞬间硬化成防御姿态，刺尖分泌的神经毒素能使猎物肌肉僵直。检测显示，其毒素对草系精灵效果加倍。
descriptionEn: Huyouli's tail is covered with venomous spikes and, when still, disguises itself as a bush branch. When sensing danger, the tail instantly hardens into a defensive posture; the neurotoxin secreted from its tip can stiffen a prey's muscles. Tests show its toxin is doubly effective against Grass-type creatures.

evolution: 多多 → 多啦多 Lv.16 → 古啦多 Lv.36
description: 头部突起越复杂代表着年龄越大，突起内部充斥剧毒毒液，被一层外套膜包裹起来。遇到危险时，会释放更为强大的致幻毒素，但是并不致命。因此，部分洛克因为想要致幻体验，而专门寻找它们。

description: 长期在暗处生存，双目视觉逐渐退化，演化出了胸前能够探测、储存幻系能量的触手。幻系能量凝聚在菌柄中，赋予了其极强的再生能力，即便是经过火焰的炙烤，依旧能迅速生出饱满的躯体。
descriptionEn: Having lived in the dark for a long time, its eyesight gradually degenerated, and it evolved tentacles on its chest capable of detecting and storing Psychic energy. The Psychic energy condensed in its stalk grants it strong regenerative abilities; even after being scorched by flames, it can quickly grow a full body again.

name: 小电企鹅
habitatEn: Commonly found in the Snowy Mountains
evolution: 小电企鹅 → 电企鹅 Lv.32
description: 它们生活在寒冷的水域，会用头顶的晶体吸收空气里的电能量。当能量充足时，晶体表面会浮现细碎的亮纹和电光。偏爱暴雪与打雷的天气，风雪越大、雷声越近，它们越活跃。
descriptionEn: They live in cold waters and use the crystal on their head to absorb electrical energy from the air. When energy is plentiful, fine bright patterns and electric light appear on the crystal's surface. They prefer blizzards and thunderstorms; the heavier the snow and the closer the thunder, the more active they become.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if the enemy is frozen, this skill's power +60; when responding to a status: doubles the freeze.

name: 电企鹅
evolution: 小电企鹅 → 电企鹅
description: 常成群扎堆出现来汲取更充沛的电能量，在寒冷区域居民的传说里，电企鹅大量聚集往往预示极端天气将至，当地还有个习俗——如果遇到雷暴天气，就把电企鹅放在房顶上，可以避免雷电损坏房屋。
descriptionEn: They often appear in groups to absorb more abundant electrical energy. In the legends of residents in cold regions, a large gathering of Dianqie often foretells extreme weather. There is also a local custom—if a thunderstorm comes, place a Dianqie on the rooftop to prevent lightning from damaging the house.

name: 针叶巡林

description: 丛林的向导，拥有修长的四肢与轻盈的骨骼结构，发育完全的角呈树枝状。“所谓的规则像是枝条，又好像荆棘。被缠上时使人烦躁，被刺伤时让人疼痛。但规则也有如树干，在支撑着森林的生命——所谓自由，亦是如此”。
descriptionEn: A guide of the jungle, with slender limbs and a light bone structure; its fully grown horns are branch-shaped. "Rules are like branches, yet also like thorns. When entangled they annoy; when stung they hurt. But rules are also like tree trunks, supporting the forest's life — such is freedom."

name: 炽心勇狮
evolution: 小勇狮 → 炽焰狮 Lv.16 → 炽心勇狮 Lv.36
description: 不休的守护者，甚至能将无私守护的意志凌驾于一般契约之上。虽然性格高傲，但对认可的伙伴极为忠诚。拥有永不熄灭的火焰心脏，绝对的正义是支持烈焰的力量源泉。 “让我见识看看吧，你的正义之心！”
descriptionEn: A tireless guardian, able to place the will of selfless protection above ordinary contracts. Though proud, it is extremely loyal to acknowledged companions. With an never-extinguishing flame heart, absolute justice is the source of its blaze's power. "Show me your heart of justice!"

name: 水蛇锁
evolution: 水滴蛇 → 水蛇锁 Lv.16 → 游蛇魔使 Lv.36
description: 水蛇锁经常悄悄靠近洛克，没有半点声响。它们不以贪婪著称，也不说谎。它们的目的是汲取你的知识。试试用最珍贵的知识与它交换，或许就能平安离开。
descriptionEn: Water-snake Lock often sneaks up on Lockes without a sound. They are not known for greed, nor do they lie. Their purpose is to absorb your knowledge. Try trading with your most precious knowledge and perhaps you can leave safely.

name: 冰封怨灵
evolution: 雪娃娃 → 冰封怨灵 Lv.26 → 雪灵 Lv.42
description: 缔结契约的向往更明显，甚至会主动靠近潜在契约者，似乎由冰元素和某种尚不清楚的物质构成，推测该物质来自强烈的信念与精神力，使它们的契约更稳定、也更难被外力改变。
descriptionEn: Its desire to form contracts is more obvious, and it even actively approaches potential contractors. It seems to be composed of ice element and some unknown substance, which is speculated to come from strong belief and mental power, making their contracts more stable and harder to change by external forces.

evolution: 雪娃娃 → 冰封怨灵 Lv.26 → 雪灵 Lv.42
description: 只有当契约者死亡的时候才会寻找下一位契约者。假如原契约者活着，但它们必须更换契约者的话，可能会自我了结生命。
descriptionEn: It only seeks a new contractor when the original one dies. If the original contractor is alive but it must change contractors, it may end its own life.

name: 游蛇魔使
evolution: 水滴蛇 → 水蛇锁 Lv.16 → 游蛇魔使 Lv.36
description: 真理的引路人，传闻它们最初的使命早已失败，但仍在守望，守望古老预言的验证，或是等待一段新的契约。它们拥有修长柔软的尾巴，据说尾巴尖端可以打开远古的知识之门。“真理从不主动现身——你愿意推开这扇门吗？”
descriptionEn: A guide to the truth. It is said that their original mission failed long ago, yet they still keep watch — watching for the fulfillment of an ancient prophecy, or waiting for a new covenant. They have long, supple tails, and it is said the tip of the tail can open the gate of ancient knowledge. “Truth never reveals itself on its own — will you push this door open?”

name: 小怂猫
evolution: 小怂猫 → 怒目怂猫 Lv.36
description: 胆量极小的精灵，曾因极少被观测记录，被王国记录为已灭绝的物种。翼膜上的眼状图案可以吓退大多数天敌，遇到敌人会张开双臂一动不动地站着，一直到对方离开或者自己昏厥。
descriptionEn: An extremely timid spirit. Because it was so rarely observed or recorded, the kingdom once listed it as an extinct species. The eye-shaped patterns on its wing membranes can scare off most natural predators; when it meets an enemy it spreads its arms and stands perfectly still until the other side leaves or it faints.

name: 怒目怂猫
evolution: 小怂猫 → 怒目怂猫 Lv.36
description: 胸脯处长着结构独特的气囊，能够迅速膨起至数倍大，形状像是血盆大口，可以吓退敌人。想回到正常姿势需要排出胸脯中的气体，排气的时候会发出非常可爱的声音，一般会在没有其他生物看到的时候偷偷排气。
descriptionEn: On its chest grows an air sac of unusual structure that can swell to several times its size, taking a shape like a gaping maw to frighten enemies. To return to its normal posture it must expel the air from its chest, and the venting makes a very cute sound, so it usually vents in secret when no other creature is watching.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; after each use, this skill's energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 技巧打击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 10x.

name: 小狮鹫（高山地的样子）
evolution: 小狮鹫 → 神圣狮鹫 Lv.32 → 皇家狮鹫 Lv.46
description: 只能勉强顶破头部的壳，剩余的蛋壳会陪伴小狮鹫度过幼年时期，能够抵御高山的严寒。皮肤表面覆盖嫩黄的绒毛，有保温发热的作用。
descriptionEn: It can barely break through the shell over its head; the rest of the eggshell stays with the young Xiaoshijiu through its infancy and can withstand the bitter cold of the high mountains. Its skin is covered with tender yellow down, which keeps it warm and generates heat.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 1 hit; if attacking before the enemy, changed to 3 hits.

skills.name: 啄击
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 2 hits.

skills.name: 飞羽
skills.description: 迅捷，驱散敌方1种增益。
skills.descriptionEn: Swift; dispels 1 buff from the enemy.

skills.name: 乘风
skills.description: 自己获得速度+120。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains SPD +120.

skills.name: 防御
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 见招拆招
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合使用状态技能，本次技能威力+55。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if a status skill was used last turn, this use's skill power +55.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +20 power to all skills; swift.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if attacking before the enemy, this use's skill power +50%.

skills.name: 三连破
skills.description: 自己获得物攻+30%，3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Phys. ATK +30%; 3 hits.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher your SPD is compared with the enemy's, the higher this use's skill power.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains SPD +80; when countering a defense skill: changed to SPD +160.

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: forces the enemy to emergency-withdraw at the end of the turn.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; swift; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 1.5x.

name: 圆眼蜘蛛
evolution: 圆眼蜘蛛 → 尖角蜘蛛 Lv.24 → 芋香巨角蛛 Lv.40
description: 幼体的圆眼蜘蛛并不太能织网捕食，多以青草，树果为食。复眼获取信息范围极大，速度极快，即便是独眼，圆眼蜘蛛获取信息速度远超过洛克族100倍。
descriptionEn: As a larva, Yuanyanzhizhu is not very good at spinning webs to catch prey, and mostly feeds on grass and berries. Its compound eyes take in an extremely wide range of information at extremely high speed; even with a single eye, Yuanyanzhizhu gathers information more than 100 times faster than the Loch people.

skills.name: 蛰针
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 虫茧
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得10%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Self recovers 20% HP; your team gains 1 Dedication: gains 10% lifesteal.

skills.name: 虫网
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; self recovers 1 energy.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each stack of Poison on the enemy, self gains Magic ATK +30%.

skills.name: 啃咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，本技能会受奉献影响，每被影响1次，能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 1 hit; this skill is affected by Dedication, and for each time it is affected, its energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 力量增效
skills.description: 自己获得物攻+100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Phys. ATK +100%.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 贮藏
skills.description: 自己获得双攻+50%，每携带1个0能耗技能，额外+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains both ATK stats +50%; for each 0-energy-cost skill carried, an additional +50%.

skills.name: 毒泡泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 落井下毒
skills.description: 使敌方精灵减益的层数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the number of debuff stacks on the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 落星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Poison.

skills.name: 毒囊
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层中毒，应对状态：改为获得6层。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Poison; when countering a status skill: changed to 6 stacks.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each stack of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost -1; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 虫击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为2倍，无视敌方系别抵抗。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 2x and ignores the enemy's type resistance.

name: 尖角蜘蛛
evolution: 圆眼蜘蛛 → 尖角蜘蛛 Lv.24 → 芋香巨角蛛 Lv.40
description: 各关节都覆盖着绒毛，绒毛可以疏水和保暖。在湿滑的雨天也可以自由行走，世界的动态在它们眼里显得很慢，所以大部份尖角蜘蛛都是急性子。
descriptionEn: Every joint is covered with fine hair that repels water and retains warmth. It can walk freely even on slippery rainy days, and the world's motion looks very slow to them, so most Jianjiaozhizhu are impatient.

name: 芋香巨角蛛
evolution: 圆眼蜘蛛 → 尖角蜘蛛 Lv.24 → 芋香巨角蛛 Lv.40
description: 颜色鲜艳美丽，尾部丝囊中的液体有剧毒，织出的蜘蛛网散发异香。依靠体毒和利刺能轻易捕获猎物，从不群居，个体之间都保持一定距离，互不侵犯。
descriptionEn: Brightly and beautifully colored, the fluid in the silk glands at its tail is highly toxic, and the webs it spins give off a strange fragrance. Relying on its body venom and sharp spines it captures prey easily. It never lives in groups; individuals keep a certain distance from one another and do not encroach on each other.

name: 波波螺
evolution: 波波螺 → 消波螺 Lv.16 → 嗜波螺 Lv.32
description: 经常频繁抖动身体，推测是缓解外壳生长带来的不适感。它们常集体排成一列迎向海浪，借助外壳的结构消解冲击。浪头拍来时会张口吸入送上门的食物，连很硬的东西也能消化。
descriptionEn: It frequently shakes its body, which is presumed to relieve the discomfort caused by the growth of its shell. They often line up in a group to face the waves, using the structure of their shells to dissipate the impact. When a wave breaks over them they open their mouths and suck in the food delivered to them, and can even digest very hard things.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the lower the enemy's weight, the higher the power.

skills.name: 地陷

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; self gains Phys. DEF +70%; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power is doubled, and Phys. DEF additionally +70%.

name: 消波螺
evolution: 波波螺 → 消波螺 Lv.16 → 嗜波螺 Lv.32
description: 进化后，外壳生长速度更快，更需要精心维护——它们会定期在岩石上打磨外壳。个体之间还会互相叠在一起摩擦打磨，发出“砰砰”的声响。若较长时间没有打磨，行动会明显变慢。
descriptionEn: After evolving, its shell grows even faster and needs more careful maintenance — they regularly grind their shells on rocks. Individuals also pile on top of one another to rub and grind, making a “bang bang” sound. If they go without grinding for a long time, their movement slows noticeably.

description: 在古老的遗迹中发现了九幽菇的石雕，当时的洛克对九幽菇充满了崇拜，它们会在仪式上围着九幽菇唱歌，并在祭祀的指导下服用其孢子，进入幻觉，企图沟通神明，然而也存在接触它的孢子太久而神志不清的情况，等等，难道我也……
descriptionEn: Stone carvings of Jiuyougu were found in ancient ruins. The Roco of that time worshipped Jiuyougu; they would sing around it in rituals and, guided by priests, consume its spores to enter hallucinations, attempting to communicate with the gods. name: 棋齐垒（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋齐垒（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “黑子从不主动寻找白子，但是却总会在转向的时候留下一排空位，学者推测这是黑子对换班记忆的折射，即便时代更迭，它们仍在试图完成那场和白子的交接。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十四》
descriptionEn: The black pieces never actively seek the white pieces, yet always leave a row of empty spaces when turning. Scholars speculate this reflects the black pieces' memory of shift changes; even as eras pass, they still try to complete that handover with the white pieces. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XIV'

evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋祈督（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “曾经有洛克试图用黑子的外壳打造行军的铠甲，却在淬火瞬间听见棋子内部传来低沉的声音，黑暗中工匠们的影子被炉火吞噬，所有想要拆解棋子的工匠都遭遇了不幸。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十六》
descriptionEn: Once a Rocco tried to use the black piece's shell to forge marching armor, but at the quenching moment heard a low voice from inside the piece; in the darkness the craftsmen's shadows were swallowed by the furnace fire, and all craftsmen who tried to dismantle the pieces met misfortune. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XVI'

name: 棋绮后（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋绮后（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “黄金时代崩解后不知多久，黑子开始失眠。它们不再在日出时准点沉睡，而是继续在废土上继续巡逻。没有族人可守，它们便去围着倒塌的遗迹转圈，被认为是一种刻板行为。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十三》
descriptionEn: Some time after the collapse of the Golden Age, the black pieces began to suffer insomnia. They no longer sleep on schedule at sunrise, but keep patrolling the wasteland. With no kin to guard, they circle the collapsed ruins, considered a stereotypic behavior. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XIII'

name: 奔波鼠
evolution: 奔波鼠 → 流浪鼠 Lv.32
description: 毛色杂乱且粗糙，像是融合了泥土、枯叶的颜色，黑色的眼睛透露出机灵的光。它们背着自己的全部家当，在野外长期流浪，一直在路上，从未到达旅途的终点。有着健壮的身躯，但进攻意愿低，只对闪闪发光的东西兴趣浓厚。
descriptionEn: Its fur is messy and coarse, as if blended with the colors of dirt and dead leaves, and its black eyes show a clever gleam. Carrying all its belongings, it wanders in the wild for long periods, always on the road, never reaching the journey's end. It has a sturdy body but low willingness to attack, interested only in shiny things.

name: 流浪鼠
habitat: 偶见于城镇 / 流浪精灵
habitatEn: Occasionally seen in towns / Wandering spirit
evolution: 奔波鼠 Lv.32 → 流浪鼠
description: 背后鼓鼓的行囊里是更多捡来的收藏品，闪闪发光的物体对它们有着无与伦比的吸引力。不论是亮晶晶的小石子，闪着微光的菌类，还是洛克不小心遗落的饰品。在劳累之后，它们也会静静地在波光粼粼的水面望着月亮。
descriptionEn: In the bulging pack on its back are more collected trinkets; shiny objects hold an unparalleled attraction for them. Whether glittering pebbles, faintly glowing fungi, or accessories a Rocco accidentally dropped. After tiring, they quietly watch the moon on the shimmering water surface.

description: 幼年期较长，主要靠嗅闻、聆听和头上叶子的触觉来获取信息。头顶毛发会散发出爆米花的香味，偶尔引来其他精灵。它们之间用互闻头顶代表问候。
descriptionEn: Its juvenile period is long; it mainly obtains information by smelling, listening, and the touch of the leaf on its head. The hair on top emits a popcorn scent, occasionally attracting other creatures. They greet each other by sniffing each other's heads.

descriptionEn: Each Wudonglulu carries an egg, often seen wiping it with the hair on its head; that is the part they treasure most. Under the fluffy fur no eyes are visible; it mainly senses the environment through the leaf on its head, and its body is very flexible.

skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: enemy gains 2 layers of Starfall Mark.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when in slot 1 or 3, power +30; Transmission 1.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when in slot 1 or 3, energy cost -2; Transmission 1.

skills.name: 错乱

name: 公平鸽
evolution: 公平鸽
description: 第一、绝对不放过任何争执！第二、绝对不能因为睡过头晚到现场！第三、绝对要公正裁判！第四、绝对要在被双方驱逐之前做出判决。——《公平鸽的守则》
descriptionEn: First, never let any dispute go unattended! Second, never be late to the scene because of oversleeping! Third, always judge fairly! Fourth, always render a verdict before being driven off by both sides. — The Code of Gongpingge

skills.name: 拍击

skills.name: 摇篮曲
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+3，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains +3 energy cost to all skills; when countering a defense skill: additionally causes an interrupt, and the enemy is stunned next turn.
